Summary: RT by @Haaretz: RT by @Haaretz: Publication by @JoshBreiner and mine: In an unusual agreement, the police will compensate 13 protesters against the government who were strip-searched in Jerusalem. Senior officials in the public prosecutor's office and in the legal counsel of the police made it clear to Police Commissioner Danny Levy that "it is impossible to protect the police officers" in the naked search files, because the tests were conducted unnecessarily and contrary to the law - as emerged from the police and prosecutor's investigation.
